# AdapterSpec variant order, append-only.
#
# `AdapterSpec` is persisted in consensus state through bincode, so its variant
# order is a wire format: a variant that moves, disappears or is inserted rather
# than appended reinterprets every stored registration. The gate
# `finality-acceptance-surface-is-append-only` reads this file and requires the
# tree to declare exactly these variants, in exactly this order.
#
# Appending a family is the intended growth. Do it in one change:
#   1. add the variant at the END of `AdapterSpec` in
#      `src/cross_domain/external/intake.rs`;
#   2. append the same name here.
EthereumSync
ZkVm
BitcoinSpv
TendermintCommit
DataAvailability
HotStuffQc
DagCertificate
CasperFfg
MysticetiDag
BitVmCovenant
Nipopow
# Families that exist on the delivery branch (Babylon EOTS, NIPoPoW superblock,
# GHOSTDAG, HoneyBadgerBFT) are not declared on this branch; their patches
# append them at the end of the enum and to this file in the same change.
